subject: *: fix global index work with `memIndexReader` executor (#52660)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent (executor/expression/planner/statistics). Key changes: move global-index partition filtering into the planner via a pushed-down `IN(_tidb_pid, ...)` selection; propagate pruned partition IDs into `UnionScanExec` and filter txn mem-buffer global-index rows in `memIndexReader`; fix mem index decoding for unsigned IntHandle and `ExtraPhysTblID` offset handling; tweak explain formatting for `in(_tidb_pid, -1)`. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: follow-up commits further adjust union-scan keep-order handling and preserve `PartitionHandle` when normalizing YEAR common handles; no Blocker/High issues remain.
